purpose: Finite native-query approximation comparison with equal allocated FP32 retained-cache bytes; not native-cache minimality, global learner optimality, language-model accuracy, or a new theoretical core.

assets.model_gate: Inherit strict251 keys/shapes/cast equality/tied weights and ordinary FP32 eager text-only path from admitted native protocol. Root pins new capture/worker hashes before GO. No alternative model/runtime.

population.prompts: All64 frozen rows in unchanged order, no labels
population.eligible: T>=64; retain INELIGIBLE row otherwise; no replacement prompt
population.capture: One QKV hook per prompt; retain native heads0:4. q_h is original64D query/8, K_h and raw V_h from prefix0:16. No c_proj call required for pre-W_O block outputs. Raw arrays remain in owned private dev1 run directory.

target.formula: Y_H(q)=concat_h[softmax(q_h K_h^T)V_h] in R^(64H), H in{2,4}
target.query: q=concat_h q_h, each already /8; no additional1/sqrt(64H) in any flat/fusion kernel
target.not_claimed: No full12-head output, W_O image, growing causal cache, downstream accuracy, or target-dependent output projection.

reference.H2_identity_gate: All cal and held queries:FP64 maxerr<=1e-9*(1+maxabs(Y));FP32<=2e-5*(1+maxabs(Y)); technical stop on failure
reference.H4_rule: Teacher is direct four-head block concatenation. The known product identity is algebraic background; no65536-atom K/V arrays or H4 numerical full-fusion check are required or claimed.

fairness.counts: Materialized FP32 K,V,b and flat uint8 unused padding. SeparateH normalizers, flat1. Total query dimension and output dimension64H both arms; each separate head accesses its64D query block/output block. No learned query/output map. SeparateHn atoms vs flatn is deliberate under equal retained coefficients/allocated bytes. K andV coefficient counts separately equal; positive log-mass counts differ.
fairness.excluded_from_retention: Frozen original capture/reference, optimizer states, training workspace, query reconditioning statistics after folding, and transient inference activations; report these separately, not as zero cost.
fairness.training_compute: Equal512 K/b updates,32cal queries,4starts per arm/budget; not equal FLOPs, wall time, ridge solve count, or number of normalizers.

conditioning.r_hj: max(sqrt(mean_cal(q_hj^2)),1e-6), cal only, recomputed for native head0:4 once
conditioning.output_scale: s_H=max(sqrt(mean_cal_allD(Y_H^2)),1e-8), one scalar shared across arms for eachH; flag floor activation.

objective.formula: J=||AV-Y_H/s_H||F^2/(N*D)+lambda*||V||F^2/D; separate sums allH64D residual and value-norm terms using the sameD=64H denominator.
objective.conditional_value_solution: (A^T A + N*lambda I) V = A^T (Y/s), separately per head for separate; FP64 Cholesky, no pseudoinverse or alternate solver fallback.
objective.gradient: Envelope gradient: solve V exactly at current K,b, detach V for K,b autograd of normalized residual; the ridge term has no direct K,b derivative. Save stationarity residual; relative residual <=1e-8 using denominator max(1,||A^TY/s||F).
objective.optimizer: Adam on Kprime,b only:lr.03,betas(.9,.999),eps1e-8, no decay/clipping. FP64training.512updates/start;513conditionalVsolves per head (one before every update and final).
objective.gauge: After each update center every key coordinate across atoms and center b. Softmax stable logit subtraction. Store finite log masses b, whose exponentials are positive constants mathematically; do not prune or zero masses. No silent clipping/reinitialization.

initialization.rng: NumPy PCG64 SeedSequence([base_start_seed,prompt_index,H,head_id,n]);head_id0:H for separate,head_idH for flat; four base seeds fixed. No adaptive draws.
initialization.pool: Separate: all16 native keys/head, transformed bycalr. FlatH2:all256 Cartesian keys. FlatH4:512 distinct tuple indices sampled uniformly without replacement from[0,65536), using the predeclared per-start PCG64 stream; decode base16 to four prefix indices and materialize only those512 concatenated keys. This is an initialization candidate subset, not a support restriction on learned arbitrary keys.
initialization.kmeans: kmeans++ squared Euclidean in transformed coordinates on the fixed candidate pool, first point uniform index; ties smallest index; zero distance sum chooses lowest unchosen index.20fixedLloyd updates; emptycenter retained. Assign ties lowest center; no heldout access.
initialization.bias: b=log(cluster_count+1e-3), then centered. Values are always solved from cal targets, not cluster value averages.

selection_and_export.final_states: Export every start after512updates: keys folded to original q, values multiplied by s, b centered; all castFP32, finite check, materialized arrays.
selection_and_export.selector: After512updates export all starts toFP32original-space keys/values/logmasses. Recompute calibration MSE withFP64kernel fromFP32arrays; choose lowestcalMSE, ties smallest startindex. Freeze selector JSON/hash for all64x2Hconditionsx2budgetsx2arms before heldout evaluation.
selection_and_export.heldout: Only after selector freeze evaluate selected starts and all4 final starts for transparency; never select/tune/restart using heldout. Head/layer/budget/seed/step changes prohibited.

diagnostics.ranks: For eachH preserve caltarget uncentered/row-centered singular values per64Dhead and concatenatedD dimensions; calqueryrank<=32 and centeredtargetrank<=31, so D=128/256 alone does not imply independent task dimensions. Save each finalsoftmaxA rank. Effective rank singularvalue>1e-6*largest (rank0 iflargest0); no filtering.
diagnostics.ridge: Record condition number of A^TA+NlambdaI, stationarity residual, J/residualMSE/ridge term, finite gradients/parameters, training loss checkpoints0,128,256,384,512.
diagnostics.compute: Record walltime and actual perH/arm/budget/start updates plus value-solve counts/sizes. Count separateH vsflat1. Proxy terms:logits NMdkey, prediction NMdvalue, Gram NM^2,RHS NMdvalue,Cholesky O(M^3); labeledsymbolicproxy, not measuredhardwareFLOPs. Four starts are optimization repetitions, not IID datasets.

evaluation.primary: Perprompt heldout NRMSE=sqrt(mean_allheldqueries_allD((pred-Y_H)^2))/sqrt(mean(Y_H^2)); denominatorheldreference, notcals_H. Equalpromptmacro;pairedDelta=flatNRMSE-separateNRMSE separatelyfor eachH,budget. H2primary;H4nestedmechanismreplication.
evaluation.secondary: Macro and median Delta, fraction Delta>0, method macro/median NRMSE, pooled raw RMSE, worst absolute error, cal/held gap, all4 starts and selected index. No best-heldout score.
evaluation.degenerate: If held target RMS<1e-8 retain raw metrics and mark normalized metric undefined; report counts and no silent dropping. Keep all64 row statuses.
evaluation.uncertainty: No IID prompt assertion, significance test, confidence interval, all-query supremum, best-possible-flat conclusion, NLP accuracy or end-to-end speedup.

execution_gate.before_any_run: Root reviews contract/code and pins newcapture/worker/runtimehashes; freshprivateGPUidle/ownedlocks; hardGPUjob300s plus ownedcleanup. This protocol does not independently admit capture orfit. No timebasedarm-specificearlystopping.
execution_gate.failure: Stop job onload/hash/H2identity/nonfinite/Cholesky/stationarityfailure or300swallcap. Atomicpartialcheckpoints include completedsteps/inflight/selectorstate; retainall64/H/budgetstatuses. No retry/seedchange/fallback. If incomplete, do not claim full frozencomparison or pool unequal-step arms. No postdeadline salvage by selecting winning completedconditions.

interpretation_gate.weak_signal: H2primary:separate lower thanflat in macro andmedianselected-startNRMSE atbothbudgets, withstartdispersion/degeneratecounts. H4 reports correspondingpredeclarednestedmechanismresult whether positive ornegative; it doesnotrescue a negativeH2primary result.
interpretation_gate.falsification: If flat is no worse inH2macro atbothbudgets, primaryempiricaladvantage unsupported here; mixedmetrics/budgets aremixed. H4result alwaysreportedseparately. Neither localfittedsuccess norfailure provesnativecacheminimum orglobaloptimality.
interpretation_gate.kill: After singlefrozen64bank/twoH/twobudget/fourstart run stop; nohead/layer/seed/stepchanges afterheldout. Technicalfailure or300scap yieldsincompleteasset, notpositivechasing.
interpretation_gate.remaining_asset: Public reproducible finite-budget cache-fitting protocol, strict resource ledger, full128D capture metadata, all start curves, heldout results, and controlled failure evidence; one existing paper only.

pre_execution_amendment: H4 mechanism replication added before code generation/capture/fitting/heldout evaluation; original H2-only draft preserved as superseded. Root approval of final implementation/run remains required.

head_conditions.primary: H2 is the predeclared primary direct comparison; H4 is a predeclared nested-head mechanism replication, not independent replication or an alternative chosen after results. Both budgets reported for each H.
head_conditions.same_capture: AllH2/H4 conditions use same64 text forwards and native heads0:4; no extra prompt/model cohort.
